# Parity fixtures

`golden.json` holds OHLCV fixtures plus the **expected** stage / consolidation /
pivot / ATR / score / signal / trade-level values, generated by running the
**live Python reference engine** (`../../../../backend`) on those exact bars.

`tests/parity.test.ts` asserts the TypeScript engine reproduces every value to 6
decimals. This is the source of truth for logic parity.

## Regenerate

The generator lives at `backend/scripts/gen_golden.py`:

```bash
cd backend
PYTHONUTF8=1 PYTHONPATH="$(pwd)" .venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/gen_golden.py \
  > ../screener-ts/packages/core/tests/fixtures/golden.json
```

It builds five deterministic scenarios (seeded RNG) spanning every stage (0/2/4)
and every signal, including an ATR-expansion case that scores **negative** —
which pins the "no lower clamp on the ATR score term" behavior.
